title: The Art of Embers
author: Barış Kısır
premise: An essay collection on fire: the hearth, the kitchen, the forge, the bonfire, the burnout, the phoenix. Through a year of fires — the literal and the metaphorical — a writer examines what we burn, what we keep, and what rises. Twelve essays, one year, every flame accounted for.
